_comment: External command-line tool manifest for scripts/fetch_tools.py.
Each entry is one release archive, pinned by URL, byte size and sha256. The
archive is downloaded to a .part file, checked against both, and only then
unpacked. 'strip' is the archive's top-level folder, removed from every
member path. 'keep' lists what is unpacked, as a file name or a folder
ending in '/'; every other member stays inside the archive and never
touches the disk. 'dest' is relative to the repository root and must be its
own folder inside tools/, which is gitignored, outside tools/_downloads:
installing replaces it whole, so fetch_tools.py refuses any other dest.
'binary' is the executable inside 'dest' that --path prints.
`fetch_tools.py --licenses` prints them. These tools run on the host from
tools/, so nothing here is copied into the published image.

tools.name: rhubarb
tools.title: Rhubarb Lip Sync
tools.license: MIT (code); bundled components under the notices in LICENSE.md
tools.note: Only rhubarb, res/ and LICENSE.md are unpacked. The zip's extras/EsotericSoftwareSpine/rhubarb-for-spine-1.14.0.jar bundles OpenJFX (GPL-2.0 with Classpath Exception) and javax.json (CDDL-1.1 or GPL-2.0), and LICENSE.md does not list it, so it is never extracted. The binary needs GLIBC_2.29 and GLIBCXX_3.4.26 or newer and must sit next to res/.
